items.title: "German Husband", the creator's husband the internet never sees
items.summary: A post pointed out that Uyen Ninh, a Vietnamese creator whose videos are about life with her "German Husband", has kept his face off the internet even though he's in almost every video. It got 245K likes, and the top quote post showed she hides him in her comics too, with a leaf over his face.
items.author: @MiMimUta

post.name: ❤️Mimu💛
post.text: This woman has done a better job censoring her husband from the internet than most people have done for their children and babies (despite him being in almost every video)
